metadata.description: Plan a fictional volunteer shoreline cleanup against access, tide and group size constraints.

tools.name: coordinator

function.description: Ask the scout for a site and hand its pick to the checker. Optionally ask a peer for a volunteer briefing; report a refusal if no site qualifies.

tools.instructions: Delegate site selection to scout. Have checker independently review the selected site against every constraint. Include source receipts. Never relax a constraint. When explicitly requested, delegate a generic briefing request to briefing_peer without sending local context.

tools.name: scout

function.description: Read the site's fictional catalog and select the first site meeting crew, access and tide constraints.

tools.instructions: Read the read_cleanup_sites site action. Return the first site that meets the requested constraints, or no match.

tools.name: checker

function.description: Independently verify a proposed site against the original constraints using the catalog.

tools.instructions: Re-read read_cleanup_sites. Confirm capacity, access and tide constraints; return the individual checks.
